main.description: Deletes the dev.knotless.block records of the account logged in to this appview's web pages naming the account, from all its repositories or from the one repository named, as `knotless unblock` does. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account.

errors.description: The account is the one asking, or the repository is not its own.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

description: Unblocks an account as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
